planets.name: K2-43 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-43 with a 3.47-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: K2-43 b was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around K2-43. Its orbit and size follow Hedges et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
